A TWO-MINUTE WALKTHROUGH

Show the welcome. Then the workflow.

01

Choose a business

Switch between a boutique hotel, a salon, and a home services company. Each has its own profile, conversation, and inbox.

02

Start a conversation

Ask about prices, opening hours, parking, or cancellations. Try an unknown question to see the handoff option.

03

Capture a request

Request a stay or appointment. Enter example details and save it. It remains pending until a staff member reviews it.

04

Take the staff view

Open Requests, review details, and confirm or cancel. Export your demo requests to a CSV file.

What is working in this prototype?

A browser voice receptionist demo with microphone recognition where supported, spoken replies, a voiced sample call, step-by-step booking conversations, business customization, request validation, staff handoffs, local persistence, and CSV exports.

What needs a live connection?

Generative AI conversations, real phone calls, WhatsApp Business messaging, shared accounts, calendar availability, payments, and sending confirmations. The voice demonstration uses guided local logic rather than a live AI model. Browser recognition can use your browser vendor’s speech service.

All business names, services, and prices in the demo are fictional. Use example customer details only. This is a public demonstration. Staff controls affect only example records in your current browser. Do not enter real customer information.
